title: Beetle Between Specters
description: A large black beetle with prominent horns stands centered on a dark, textured peak. Two hooded, ghostly figures with open mouths and patterned robes float above it against a split black and white smoky background, surrounded by colorful translucent circles and small insect motifs.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a large detailed horned beetle standing on a black textured peak. Two floating hooded specters with open screaming mouths and circular patterned robes hover above it. The background is split between white smoky texture on the left and solid black with white circles and X symbols on the right. Colorful translucent orbs in red, yellow, green, purple, and blue float throughout the lower half along with tiny insect drawings. High contrast, mystical and eerie atmosphere.
